findings.finding: Guidance track row FY2025 capex_incl_finance_leases: the guiding release of 2025-01-29 (reading/release_2025-01-29..., line 50) says 'full year 2025 capital expenditures will be in the range of $60-65 billion' without the 'including principal payments on finance leases' wording that the actual 72,215 million (purchases 69,691 + finance-lease principal 2,524, release 2026-01-28) uses. The same release reports 2024 capex including finance-lease principal (39.23 billion), so the basis is probably the same, but it is not stated in the guide itself. The 1.155 ratio (guide missed by 15.5%) is also driven by mid-year raises (64-72, 66-72, 70-72), so it reflects capex being raised during the year rather than a forecasting error.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json guidance_track period FY2025 metric capex_incl_finance_leases (source_ids pf_rel_20250129_1, pf_rel_20260128_1)
findings.fix: Add a note to the row saying the January 2025 guide did not state the finance-lease basis and that it was raised three times during 2025. Do not use this row as a capex-guide bias without that caveat.

findings.finding: Price basis: nm_ib_snapshot last 614.00 has is_close false and ts 2026-10-30T23:59:56Z, so it is an after-hours last trade, not the official close. nm_ib_history gives the October bar close as 614.99. The difference is 0.16% and does not change the valuation.
findings.fix: Label the quote as the 2026-10-30 last trade (after-hours), or use the 614.99 regular-session close, and keep the label consistent in the table.

findings.finding: Trailing GAAP P/E 'now 20.9' (614.00 / 29.33) uses TTM diluted EPS that includes one-offs: the Q1 2026 discrete CAMT tax benefit of 8.03 billion (dc_tax_camt_benefit_q1_2026, about +3.1 per share), the Q3 2026 legal charge of 9.89 billion (-3.57 per share, release) and the Q2 2026 legal charges of 2.4 billion. These roughly offset, so the level holds, but the median of 27.1 it is compared with was also computed on unadjusted EPS, including trough 2022-2023 EPS.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json fact nm_eps_diluted_ttm_2026_09_30 and notes 'nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY'
findings.fix: Give the one-off items next to the trailing P/E (or an ex-one-off TTM EPS of about 30.5 as derived). Do not read 20.9 vs 27.1 as cheapness without that note.

findings.finding: Provenance flags disagree. The same issuer filings (FWP of 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-27, and the 8-K of 2026-10-29) are independent=false under dc_ ids and independent=true under nm_ and mc_ ids. prep.json shows pack-merge keeps the dc_ ids, so the merged pack carries false where the pf_ issuer documents carry true. Separately, nm_av_income / nm_av_cashflow name only the 10-Q (pf_10q_20261022) as syndicated_from, but their FY2025 annual rows come from the 10-K (pf_10k_20260129).
findings.where: gather/documents.json sources dc_fwp_launch_20261026, dc_fwp_pricing_20261026, dc_8k_20261029, dc_s3asr_20261026, dc_424b5_fwd_20261028, dc_424b5_pref_20261028; gather/numbers.json sources nm_av_income, nm_av_cashflow
findings.fix: Set independent=true on the dc_ issuer SEC filings, consistent with the pf_ and nm_ issuer documents. Name pf_10k_20260129 as well in the AV sources' syndicated_from (or in a note). No number changes.
